title: Spielberg's live IMAX interview for Disclosure Day

tellings.quote: Yes. Might be. He said last night at our at the thing that you and I were watching in the live interview at at the IMAX,

plain: Bryce Zabel, a television writer and producer, says that in 2026 he and Michels watched a live interview with Steven Spielberg at an IMAX theater for Spielberg's film Disclosure Day, and that Spielberg said something there that bore on whether the film reflects real knowledge of UFOs. Zabel brings it up on the show as something he saw himself, leaving open how much Spielberg meant by it.
